import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    if not data:
        return

    n = int(data[0])
    counts = [0] * (n + 1)

    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        counts[i] = counts[i >> 1] + (i & 1)

    sys.stdout.write(" ".join(map(str, counts)) + "\n")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```
